name: Chitwan National Park
description: Chitwan National Park covers about 950 square kilometres of lowland jungle and grassland in south-central Nepal, beneath the Himalayan foothills. Created in 1973 as the country's first national park, it protects one of the last intact stretches of the Terai plains. Visitors come to look for one-horned rhinoceroses and elusive Bengal tigers in a landscape that rises from river valleys to the Sivalik Hills.
